i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load issue #439, ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, analysis_refresh.md runbook, gold config schema, fantasy scoring, 2025 calendar/DB coverage. Record pass when loaded.

q1-approach.title: Build+run sequencing given true size
q1-approach.imperative: Issue #439 is not a one-command run: periods 1-3 need NEW leakage-safe in-season-cutoff training capability (gold config has no round cutoff) + per-period compound rebuilds + 4 full gold+fusion+calibration trainings (multi-hour each). Decide: (A) full build + full-fidelity run now; (B) build + smoke-validate end-to-end correctness cheaply, then launch full run; (C) feasibility spike on one period first. Recommend B.

q2-fidelity.title: Per-period pipeline fidelity
q2-fidelity.imperative: Confirm each period runs the full pipeline (gold cycle + static fusion + calibration + materialize bundles) so fantasy scoring consumes trained/fused predictions, vs gold-modules-only. Issue says gold+fusion+calibration. Recommend full.

q3-compute.title: Compute budget / scheduling
q3-compute.imperative: Where/when to run the heavy trainings (background on this machine, --utilization max?), and is the machine dedicated for the duration. Recommend max if dedicated.

q4-output.title: Output location/format + deliverable
q4-output.imperative: Report path (reports/strategy/ vs new reports/.../walkforward_2025/) and whether deliverable is committed report only or reusable orchestrator code too. Recommend new path + committed report + reusable orchestrator.

q5-period0.title: Period 0 reuse vs retrain
q5-period0.imperative: Period 0 (train 2018-2024, predict R1-6) equals the current promoted gold model. Reuse promoted gold artifacts for period 0 (save one full training) or retrain fresh for uniformity. Recommend reuse if promoted gold config matches (anchor on, quali_pace_gap).
